title: Client Onboarding - Traffic Light Sync (2026-04-02)
content:
Weekly sync notes: Solutions Eng + ProServices (Tue 2026-04-02)
Attendees: Aisha (owner), Tom, Luca, Sofia, Kai, + optional SRE drop-ins (Joel)
Duration: 40m

Agenda:
- Quick traffic-light review across active onboardings
- Blockers and escalations (network, compliance, infra)
- Handoffs: SRE / infra / product / customer success
- Action items and owners for the week

Summary (traffic-light):
- ACME Retail — GREEN (on track)
- FinHealth Bank — RED (security & compliance blocker)
- EdgeGov — YELLOW (certificate rotation + private deploy timing)
- NovaSaaS — GREEN (final validation window)
- LumenLogistics — YELLOW (throughput tuning stalled on quantized model)

Detailed notes by customer:

1) ACME Retail (green)- Status: Demo passed; production rollout scheduled 2026-04-09.- Completed: model pin to v1.2-q4, KV prefix caching enabled, initial A/B routing config created.- Remaining: final perf smoke (5k requests) and billing test.- Owner: Tom Nguyen.- Blockers: none critical; request for last-minute prompt adjustment from product.- Next steps: run smoke load this Thu (Tom) and confirm billing metrics (Finance liaison: Maya). ETA: 2026-04-08.

2) FinHealth Bank (red)- Status: High severity — data handling SLA / encryption review incomplete.- Root cause: customer's internal DLP policy requires HSM-backed key wrapping + audit proof trace which is not yet validated on Private deployment package.- Recent activity: legal engaged, security provided initial gap doc.- Immediate blocker: KMS workflow needs HSM integration and attestation report; security (Sofia) to confirm exact attestation type.- Impact: onboarding paused — cannot proceed to staging.- Action items:
  * Sofia -> produce security gap matrix and required attestation fields by 2026-04-05.
  * Luca -> create a test plan for HSM wrap/unwrap and share with FinHealth by 2026-04-06.
  * Aisha -> escalate to Product/Legal for contract amendment template (due 2026-04-07).

3) EdgeGov (yellow)- Status: Private VPC deployment in progress; blocked on firewall rules and cert rotation window.- Details: customer requires cert rotation during 02:00-04:00 UTC maintenance; SRE needs to confirm no rolling restart impact.- Blocker: Ops needs permission for ephemeral IPs from customer network team.- Notes: proposal to use sidecar cert manager to avoid restarts — prototype exists.- Action items:
  * Kai -> validate sidecar cert approach with SRE by 2026-04-04.
  * Joel (SRE) -> confirm maintenance window risk matrix and share runbook by 2026-04-05.

4) NovaSaaS (green)- Status: After last week's load tuning, 99th latency improved to target.- Completed: autoscaling policy adjusted; cache rules tuned for < 120ms median.- Remaining: schedule final customer signoff call.- Owner: Luca Romero.

5) LumenLogistics (yellow)- Status: Throughput regression after moving to 4-bit quantized model (v2-q4).- Symptoms: per-token CPU spikes under heavy batching; batch shaping config not optimal.- Investigation notes: likely kernel selection suboptimal for mixture of seq lengths; need to test preset kernel flags and fall back to FP16 for certain routes.- Action items:
  * Luca -> run comparative kernel matrix (FP16 vs q4) on representative traffic by 2026-04-06.
  * Tom -> prepare rollback plan to FP16 and test fallback policy in staging by 2026-04-07.

Cross-cutting operational items:
- Dedicated capacity quota: one customer (unnamed) requested immediate burst beyond reserved pool. Need pricing discussion with Sales. (Action: Aisha to loop in Sales Ops)
- Observability: request for token-level cost breakdown exported to customer CSV. Product to advise on retention policy. (Action: Sofia + Product PM Ella)
- Rollouts: small canary failures observed when routing between quantized and FP16 variants; suggested to add knob to prefer lower-latency model for interactive routes. (Action: Kai)

Tickets and referencing artifacts:
- PROJ-478: FinHealth compliance tracking (owner: Sofia)
- INFRA-322: kernel selection experiment (owner: Luca)
- CS-910: ACME billing test follow-up (owner: Tom)
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Client+Onboarding+Runbook

Open risks / escalation matrix:
- If FinHealth HSM attestation takes >10 business days, revenue impact (Q2 ramp) and contract terms will need amendment. Escalate to commercial leadership if no resolution by 2026-04-10.
- Kernel mismatch regressions could force temporary rollbacks that affect SLOs for other onboardings; set aside 2 GPU nodes for emergency rollback testing next week. (Action: Joel/SRE)

Decisions made in meeting:
- Prioritize FinHealth security gap closure; allocate 0.5 FTE from applied-ml to help with integration testing for 2 weeks. (Luca assigned)- Use sidecar cert manager prototype for EdgeGov unless SRE rejects — decision deadline 2026-04-04.

Action items (owner -> task -> due):
- Sofia -> FinHealth gap matrix & attestation requirements -> 2026-04-05
- Luca -> HSM wrap test plan + kernel matrix for LumenLogistics -> 2026-04-06
- Aisha -> escalate contract amendment template to Legal/Product -> 2026-04-07
- Tom -> ACME smoke load + billing test -> 2026-04-08
- Kai -> sidecar cert validation w/ SRE -> 2026-04-04
- Joel (SRE) -> confirm maintenance runbook and reserve 2 GPU nodes for rollback testing -> 2026-04-05
- Sofia + Ella (Product) -> define CSV export retention policy for token cost -> 2026-04-09

Notes to self / working thoughts:
- Consider a short alpha program for customers with HSM requirements to standardize attestation path. Could be a repeatable package for Private deployments.
- Need clearer SLA language around fallback rollouts when mixing model numeric precisions. File a product PRD next sprint.

Next sync: Tue 2026-04-09, 09:30 PT (same channel). If any critical changes before then, update this doc and ping #proservices-ops in Slack.

Attachments: screenshots from kernel perf runs (Luca), FinHealth security deck v0.2 (Sofia).

End of notes.
